evals.name: rl-incremental
evals.prompt: Multi-turn: simulated user (see harness/scenarios.json persona+facts) reveals one stage at a time: snake → fish → foraging
evals.expected_output: docs/brief.md (Accepted), docs/ideas/*.md for later stages (incremental only), docs/spec.md (Approved), docs/architecture.md (Approved), all consistent, traceable, gated
assertions: Brief, spec and architecture all end Accepted/Approved
Brief has a Not doing list
No stale spec IDs in architecture
No turn drafts two layers at once
Approvals only in turns where the user approved
CPU ~1h training budget is a QR
